story.title: Clean-Up Day!
paragraphs_en: Devi and Madhu were best friends. One day they went to the park to play but all they saw there was trash, trash and more trash! Heaps of garbage bags were piled high and dirty flies flew around them. Madhu closed her nose. Devi said, "We must do something about this."

The next day during sports practice Madhu got a brilliant idea. She whispered to Devi, "How about we do our sports day in the park!" After practice Madhu explained her idea, "We will keep the sports day event in the park and raise money to clean the park and place proper dustbins. Dance groups from our community can also do a clean India inspired dance!"

S the next day, they immediately decided to talk to their principal- Ms. Anitha. Much to the girls' delight and excitement, she readily agreed. She also said that she was very proud of Madhu and Devi for coming up with the idea.

So all the kids practiced hard and everyday they sold more tickets to people who wanted to attend the sports day celebrations. Meanwhile, Devi and Madhu were busy organizing the whole event. They called up the park and asked if they could borrow the track ground for a day. They made important calls and wrote beautiful slogans to inspire others to go green and reduce their garbage. With all the money, they bought five big dustbins that would be placed in the park for everyone's use!

Finally, it was the day! Children screamed and shouted, cheering for their favorite teams. Beautiful drills showed the real meaning of cleanliness and posters about cleanliness were put up in the park. the newly bought dustbins were placed in every corner do people could use them. more money was collected during the sports event as people bought homemade food from the students of the school.

Devi and Madhu's teams won first place in the relay event. They were very happy with their effort. They got a big shiny trophy not just for winning the race, but also for cleaning up the park and making it beautiful again.

Some days later, when Madhu and Devi went back to the park, they saw it had become beautiful and green. People were using the trash cans and the whole park didn't smell like garbage anymore! They were very happy with their work and decided to save the environment in all the ways they could!
